label: Example · Voice agent on a website

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi. Do you deliver to Pokhara?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes, we deliver anywhere in Pokhara within two days. Orders placed before noon go out the same day.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: And can I pay on delivery?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You can. Cash on delivery and digital wallets both work. Would you like me to send the order link to your phone?
